message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on the fact: In 2016 Aug 29, Zhao stole a bag from Wu containing a phone, 198 RMB, ID. This is theft (抢走). In Chinese criminal law, "抢夺" is a form of theft? Actually "抢夺" is a separate offense: "抢夺罪" (robbery by snatching). The description: "趁被害人不备，抢走...". That is "抢夺" (snatching). Under Chinese law, "抢夺" is a type of theft (抢夺罪) under Article 263 of Criminal Law. So the appropriate charge is "抢夺罪". Also possibly "盗窃罪"? But the fact says "抢走" which is snatching, not burglary. So the correct is "抢夺罪". Also there is "非法侵占"? No. The ID theft maybe identity theft? But not indicated. So only "抢夺罪". Provide in format: [罪名]抢夺罪<eoa>. Ensure no extra.
